UI.ToggleTip: Enable Exact Storage controls for this storage.
UI.UseStackUnitTip: Show quota values as stack instead of raw item counts. Category quotas with mixed stack sizes are only editable in stack units.
UI.SeparateLinkedStoragesTip: Apply this linked profile separately to each identical linked storage building.
UI.MinTip: Desired minimum stock. Haulers prioritize storage below this amount.
UI.MaxTip: Maximum stock. Haulers stop filling this storage at this amount and move excess elsewhere.
UI.InvalidRangeTip: Minimum is greater than maximum. This row is saved but ignored until the range is valid.
UI.InvalidCategoryTotalTip: Category quota is lower than the sum of configured child item and category quotas. This row is saved but ignored until the total is valid.
UI.SummaryWarning: Configured minimums exceed the estimated stock capacity.
UI.SummaryUnknownCapacityWarning: Exact Storage cannot estimate this storage's stock capacity. Vanilla storage checks still apply.
